Granite Guardian HAP 38M
IBM Research — Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE).
Source: https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-guardian-hap-38m
Source revision: faf9291163c7363d4a7ba7fc1dc72243214af931

Modified for Social Stream Ninja: exported to ONNX, with rowwise int8 storage
for matrix weights and float16 storage for other weights. Calculations use
float32. Tokenizer and configuration files originate from the source model.

This English classifier detects hateful, abusive and profane text. Model data
loads locally; classification does not send chat to IBM or another service.
